title: The Night Flower Opening on Time
youtube_title: The Night Flower Opening on Time | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Pilar finds a pale flower that opened when the path lamps did. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Pilar shows Oona how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
